raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Product Owner and CSPO®, CSM® & SAFe SSM® certified Business Change professional with 12+ years of experience across BFSI, Capital Markets, and Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB). Proven track record of driving client onboarding and channel enablement initiatives — leading business analysis, requirement gathering, prioritisation, and backlog management to improve the end-to-end client experience. Skilled in partnering with Client Services, Operations, Technology, and Business stakeholders to deliver strategic business change and digital transformation programmes across global teams in the US, EMEA, and APAC. Adept at translating business needs into clear functional requirements, managing risks and dependencies, and accelerating revenue realisation through data-driven, continuous process improvement.

raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Xoriant Solutions Pvt. Ltd. Mumbai Client: Citi Bank Product Owner | Business Change Lead
Jul 2024 – Present
Led end-to-end business change and product delivery for Citi’s Document Hub programme within Corporate & Investment Banking, driving requirement gathering, backlog management, and sprint execution across globally distributed teams (US, EMEA, APAC), improving delivery predictability by ~30%.
Partnered with Client Services, Operations, and Technology stakeholders to prioritise business and operational requirements, facilitating all Scrum ceremonies and driving risk/dependency management.
Identified opportunities to simplify document workflows and enhance client experience — editable PDFs, reusable templates, automated notifications — increasing operational productivity by ~40% and accelerating revenue realisation.
Built JIRA-driven dashboards for real-time tracking of velocity, burndown, and RAID logs, enabling data-driven decision-making for senior business and technology stakeholders.
HSBC Bank Ltd. Pune Product Owner | Business Change Lead
Feb 2022 – Jul 2024
Led product ownership and business change delivery for key regulatory and client-facing programmes (CPR, Digital Stamping), defining scope, gathering requirements, and managing stakeholder expectations to ensure compliance. • Partnered with Client Services, Operations, Compliance, and Technology teams to simplify processes and improve delivery efficiency by ~30%.
Streamlined backlog management and requirement clarity, reducing review cycles and accelerating regulatory approvals.
Angel One Ltd. Mumbai Product Owner | Business Change Lead
Feb 2020 – Jan 2022
Owned end-to-end business analysis and product ownership for Digital Payments & Investment account onboarding platforms (UPI, Net Banking, IPO, SIP, eMandate) — driving account opening and channel enablement from vision through delivery and launch.
Defined and managed product backlog with 300+ user stories, prioritising client onboarding and channel features based on business KPIs, customer insights, and stakeholder alignment.
Delivered measurable improvements: ~30% increase in transaction success rates and ~40% growth in customer onboarding adoption through process optimisation.
Mindgate Solutions Pvt. Ltd. Mumbai Client: SBI Bank Lead Business Analyst
Aug 2019 – Feb 2020
Led requirement elicitation, business analysis, and backlog prioritisation for UPI enhancements across key client transaction flows (Pay, Collect, AutoPay), translating business needs into actionable user stories and functional specifications.
Improved transaction success rates by ~30% through process optimisation, stakeholder alignment, and well-defined acceptance criteria ensuring high-quality delivery.
HDFC Bank Ltd. Mumbai Business Analyst
Oct 2018 – Jun 2019
Led business analysis for AML-based risk profiling solution, improving fraud detection efficiency by ~35%.
Analysed 1M+ customer records to enable data-driven risk assessment and ensure regulatory compliance with RBI guidelines.
Sharekhan by BNP Paribas Mumbai Business Analyst
Aug 2017 – Sep 2018
Led business analysis and Agile delivery for KYC integration aligned with BNPP regulatory standards, enabling risk- based onboarding workflows.
Facilitated Scrum ceremonies and stakeholder collaboration, increasing team velocity by ~30% through process optimisation.
Axis Bank Ltd. Mumbai Business System Analyst
Dec 2013 – Aug 2017
Automated corporate salary processing using RPA (Fusion), reducing FTE dependency by ~40% and improving operational efficiency.
Conceptualised and delivered the My-Cause digital platform for digital donations and tax-compliant reward redemption, enhancing customer experience across the bank's network.
